action.input: I want a way to keep track of the books I've read this year. I usually forget what I read by december. it would be nice to see them all in one place with a short note on what I thought of each one. nothing fancy.

framings.text: When I read books during the year, I forget what I read by December, I can keep track of the books I've read this year and see them all in one place with a short note on what I thought of each one, so I can remember what I read. It works if I can see each book from this year alongside a short note about my thoughts; It must be nothing fancy.
